title: Clearances from grade.
officialText:
Equipment and appliances installed at grade level shall be supported on a level concrete slab or other
approved material extending not less than 3 inches (76 mm) above adjoining grade or shall be suspended not less than 6 inches (152
mm) above adjoining grade. Such support shall be in accordance with the manufacturer’s installation instructions.
